comment: The phrase “recognised for use within the national health system” is ambiguous. Recognition may mean regulatory authorisation, formulary inclusion, procurement eligibility, emergency approval, donation acceptance, or programme use.

anchor.note: p.145 l.Lines 382-387 read as the printed page; section 1 agrees

public.text: The phrase “recognised for use within the national health system” is ambiguous. Recognition may mean regulatory authorisation, formulary inclusion, procurement eligibility, emergency approval, donation acceptance, or programme use.
public.suggestedRevision: Represent these as separate statuses and relationships, each with an authoritative source, scope, jurisdiction, and effective period.
